title: Not durable
text: Not durable. This is the second time I have replaced my Pyrex lids. They just do not last. The worst seems to be the freezing and trying to remove the lid. You cannot touch the frozen lid as it just cracks and breaks. If you are in a hurry to eat or feed your family, plan that you will go through lids frequently. They also disfigure in the microwave, so no win there either. You have to remove them. Why can't someone invent something better?
